system.description:
Once per long rest, while in a Deep Dive, you can trigger a massive network disruption. Choose up to three connected systems, devices, or cyberware-linked targets in the scene. For each one, choose one:
• Disable it until the GM spends a Fear.
• Feed it false information, giving disadvantage on its next roll.
• Overload it, causing its operator to mark 1 Stress.
• Open, lock, jam, redirect, control, or trigger it in a way that significantly changes the scene.

Afterward, mark a Stress or become temporarily Vulnerable.
